checks.name: The bundled bridge exposes existing public Lens and foottrace APIs
The adapter preserves the original snapshot and keeps callbacks outside typed agent events
Native Lens overview is returned verbatim and does not invent missing historical errors
Native writer and value tools expose the validated classifier and the changed active checkpoint
Native Lens identifies the stale validation flag and the sole tracked legacy gate input
Native causal tools retain missing-control warnings instead of manufacturing routing edges
Missing Context Integrity findings are reported as unavailable evidence, never a clean run
Foottrace replay shows the exact before/after change while preserving validation association
Repeated valid stop selections are safe and unavailable addresses are refused
Supplemental retry, native cleanup and detailed predicates remain actual source callbacks
The guarded saved run has no released reference and native Lens sees its identity guard
JSON round-trip of adapted recordings preserves native answers, state replay and callback pointers
Native tool validation, bounded values and missing-read warnings remain intact
Reopening leaves source bytes and input objects unchanged without any network call

scope: Existing saved-record Lens tools and foottrace only; no training, benchmark, provider or child process execution
